title: [全英文 HC] RMB 42–85 万/年 Senior AI Inference Infrastructure | LLM Data | Speech AI 东京 Voice AI / AI Agent 公司
contentFull:
东京的 Voice AI / AI Agent 公司，主要面向企业客户做语音 AI Agent ，从模型、推理基础设施到企业落地都有自研。
年收均为 1000–2000 万日元，可提供日本工作签证及 Relocation Support 。
1. Senior AI Inference Infrastructure Engineer
Japanese: Not required / Working language: English
Requirements:

Strong Python / PyTorch
Production GPU inference experience
Distributed / parallel inference, batching, async processing

Strong in at least one:
LLM inference: vLLM / SGLang, Prefill/Decode, KV Cache
Speech inference: ASR / TTS inference pipeline


Plus: CUDA / Triton / NCCL / TensorRT-LLM / Kubernetes / Slurm / Ray

2. Senior LLM Data Engineer
English + Japanese N2
Requirements:

Production LLM training / evaluation data experience
Python + large-scale data processing
pandas / Polars / Spark / SQL / ETL
SFT / RL data
Synthetic Data
LLM-as-a-Judge
Dataset quality / benchmark / evaluation design

3. Senior Speech AI Engineer / TTS
English + Japanese N2
Requirements:

Hands-on TTS / Speech Synthesis model R&D
Python / PyTorch
Model training and productionization
Speech data preprocessing / alignment / labeling
Experience with modern TTS architectures
Plus: Audio Codec / Flow Matching / Diffusion / LLM-based TTS

Common

Salary: JPY 10M–20M
Tokyo / Hanzomon
Overseas candidates welcome
Visa & relocation support
Remote / Full Remote can be discussed depending on the case
